FAQs
items.html:
Can I buy a single flavor once I discover my favorite?
Absolutely! Once you know which flavor your family loves most, feel free to purchase it individually—or explore it in our toothpastes, flosses, or mouth sprays, too.
What is fluoride mouthwash?
Fluoride mouthwash is a dental product that contains fluoride, a mineral known for its ability to strengthen tooth enamel and prevent tooth decay.
Is fluoridated mouthwash safe to use?
Fluoride mouthwash is generally safe when used as directed.
How often should I use fluoride rinse?
It's recommended to use fluoride rinse once or twice daily, or as directed by your dentist.
Can children use fluoride mouthwash?
Children 6 years and older can use fluoride mouthwash, but please supervise their use to avoid swallowing.
Can fluoride mouthwashes replace toothpaste?
No, fluoride mouthwashes are not a substitute for toothpaste. It is recommended to use both for optimal oral hygiene – brushing with fluoride toothpaste and rinsing with fluoride mouthwash.
How is SuperMouth Mouthwash different from typical mouthwashes?
SuperMouth Mouthwash is distinct due to its specialized formulation. It’s free from alcohol, artificial colors, flavors, preservatives, and antimicrobial agents found in many mouthwashes. Instead, it’s enriched with essential minerals, vitamins, and prebiotics, including Hydroxamin - a blend of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2. This unique mix ensures effective mouth coating and maintains an alkaline pH of 8.5 for a healthier oral microbiome.
Why is the alkaline pH of SuperMouth Mouthwash beneficial?
An alkaline pH, like the 8.5 in our mouthwash, is essential for oral health. It creates an unfavorable environment for harmful bacteria, aiding in cavity prevention and promoting a balanced oral microbiome. This pH level also makes our mouthwash gentle, enhancing overall oral hygiene.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Shake well before each use.
  • Measure out 10 ml of mouthwash.
  • Swish vigorously for 1 minute, ensuring the mouthwash reaches all areas of your mouth.
  • Spit out—do not rinse with water, so the fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite can keep working.
  • For best results, use first thing in the morning and last thing at night before bedtime.
